description: This file defines configuration functions for the Vitest testing framework, specifically for setting up boundary tests. It includes functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a configured Vitest project object with specific test settings.

methods.name: export function loadBoundaryIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadBoundaryIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for boundary tests from environment variables, using a default environment object if none is provided.

methods.name: export function createBoundaryVitestConfig( createBoundaryVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest project configuration object for boundary tests, incorporating environment-derived patterns, command-line arguments, and shared config options.
